decisions.reason: The switched 5V rail changes do not alter the standalone 3.3V supply; the same-message Event already captures the separate LDO and source-selection decisions.
The 5V boost rating and load list do not change the AXP2101 battery or USB power-path topology; the relevant same-message AXP decisions are already represented.

The source assigns SPS30 and ZE08-CH2O to the 5V rail but does not establish that their interfaces are provided through the sensor board; the explicit I2C sensor-board information is already represented.
The existing same-message Event records the SK6812 family but omits the explicit conditional assignment of those LEDs to the GPIO3-controlled 5V rail.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
3.3V rail (AXP2101 DCDC1, 2A) — primary power source when power board is connected:
\- ESP32-S3 module
\- INA219
\- All I2C sensors (SCD41, BME280, ENS160) via sensor board
\- I2C display
\- TTP223, AM312 PIR

5V rail (MT3608 boost, 500mA) — controlled by ESP32 GPIO3:
\- SPS30 particulate sensor
\- ZE08-CH2O formaldehyde sensor
\- SK6812 LEDs (if wired to 5V — depends on version)

3.3V rail (ME6211A LDO, 1A) — only active when USB-C on main board connected WITHOUT power board:
\- Same 3.3V rail as above — Schottky diode OR-ing means whichever source is present wins. Used for standalone programming.

Battery (3.7–4.2V) — feeds AXP2101 which then feeds everything above.

Simple rule: in normal operation AXP2101 powers everything. The LDO only kicks in when programming without the power board connected.

value_updates.led_supply_rule: Use the GPIO3-controlled 5V rail when the selected SK6812 version is wired to 5V

decisions.reason: The source does not change the existing interboard connector types, pinouts, or matching-order rule; its 5V and GPIO3 details are already compatible with the 5V and 5V_EN signals.
The battery voltage and AXP2101 power description do not resolve or modify the battery connector's pinout, series, mounting type, or existing ambiguity.
The source specifies rail ratings and powered loads but makes no decision about component availability, sourcing, compatibility, or cost.
The power-distribution decision does not alter battery connector placement, orientation, spacing, or mounting-hole clearance.
Identifying the I2C sensors as 3.3V loads does not change bus speed, pull-up resistance or location, cable length, or series-resistor configuration.
The electrical rail and load assignment does not alter any board-size, aspect-ratio, connector-position, mounting-hole, or enclosure-fit constraint.
The source does not change BOM completeness, part-number requirements, R6 configuration, or any other assembly-documentation obligation.
